integrity: The odd-base classification follows exactly from the digit-sum congruence modulo B-1 and a direct check of 4. The even-base constant follows from an exact residue involution, a Chinese-remainder count, fixed-modulus prime-number theory in arithmetic progressions, Mertens estimates, Brun--Titchmarsh tail control, and Landau's semiprime asymptotic. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: For even bases the result counts a necessary congruence-compatible superset, not the Smith semiprimes themselves. Prime-square terms are lower order in the asymptotic. The 2024 digital-root article was not available as open full text, but later published and public material explicitly covers the decimal two-factor digital-root pattern.
title: A base-parity law and residue-density sieve for Smith semiprimes
